name: Official London Theatre (West End & beyond)
notes: Disabled 2026-11-06: officiallondontheatre.com answers HTTP 403 to the daily scrape (refuses automated requests from GitHub servers), so per the maintenance rules we do not work around it. West End and other theatres are still covered by Ticketmaster and Skiddle. Was: Society of London Theatre listings, JSON-LD TheaterEvent on the listing page; location.title is the venue name.

name: V&A (South Kensington, East, Young V&A)
notes: Cards give type, venue and usually just 'Closes …'; exhibition detail pages have JSON-LD ExhibitionEvent with the full range.

name: National Theatre
notes: Production pages list every performance as JSON-LD; they are collapsed into one run.

name: Serpentine (South & North)
notes: Disabled 2026-11-06: serpentinegalleries.org answers HTTP 403 to the daily scrape (refuses automated requests), so per the maintenance rules we do not work around it. Serpentine South still gets exhibitions via Art Fund; Serpentine North is marked manualOnly.

name: Wellcome Collection
notes: Auto-configured by `npm run probe` on 2026-11-02. Cards re-pointed 2026-11-06 at the stable data-component="exhibition-promo"/"event-promo" links (plus the featured exhibition). Dates come from the <time> elements: event cards glue the year to the start time ("…202613:00"), which misreads.

name: Royal Museums Greenwich (NMM, Queen's House, Observatory)
notes: One listing for all RMG sites; events are filed under the National Maritime Museum for now. Auto-configured by `npm run probe` on 2026-11-02.

name: Freud Museum London
notes: Disabled 2026-11-06: freud.org.uk answers HTTP 403 to the daily scrape (refuses automated requests), so per the maintenance rules we do not work around it. Exhibitions still come via Art Fund, so the venue is not manualOnly.

name: White Cube Bermondsey
notes: White Cube's London page lists both spaces; venueFilter picks Bermondsey.

notes: All Lisson locations; venueFilter keeps London.

name: Thaddaeus Ropac London
notes: All Ropac locations; venueFilter keeps London (Ely House).

name: Pace London
notes: All Pace locations on one page; venueFilter keeps London.

name: David Zwirner London
notes: Listing has JSON-LD events with location names; venueFilter keeps London.

name: Carlos/Ishikawa
notes: Gallery's own exhibitions page (the homepage also lists artists' shows at other institutions).

name: Almine Rech London
notes: All Almine Rech locations; venueFilter keeps London.

name: Galerie Max Hetzler London
notes: All Max Hetzler locations (and the archive); venueFilter keeps London, past shows drop out.

name: Goodman Gallery London
notes: Programme page is built client-side (no exhibition links in the HTML) and mixes in non-London shows. Needs a London-only, server-rendered listing.

name: Alexandra Palace
notes: Auto-configured by `npm run probe` on 2026-11-02. Sport fixtures (ice hockey, darts, snooker) are excluded: not what the app is for.

name: indigo at The O2
notes: theo2.co.uk lists arena events too and the indigo listing isn't in the HTML. Needs an indigo-only source.

name: Art Fund exhibition listings (UK-wide; London venues kept)
notes: Art Fund's sitemap lists current/upcoming exhibitions UK-wide; each page says 'Venue, City' and the dates. Covers museums whose own sites block us (British Museum, RA, NPG, IWM…). Pages are cached ~14 days so daily runs fetch only new ones.

name: Royal Geographical Society
notes: Cards use styled-components classes — selectors match the stable name part. venueFilter drops online-only/regional events (cards say e.g. 'London and online').

name: The Courtauld Gallery
notes: Auto-configured by `npm run probe` on 2026-11-02. Research-forum talks; exhibitions come via Art Fund.

name: 180 Studios
notes: Cards carry dates for past shows only; current shows' cards are undated, so their own pages are read (detail.dates).

name: Southwark Playhouse Borough
notes: One listing for both Southwark Playhouse buildings; cards carry a 'Venue: Borough SE1' / 'Venue: Elephant SE11' tag.

name: Southwark Playhouse Elephant
notes: Same listing as southwark-playhouse-borough, filtered to the Elephant building.

name: Menier Chocolate Factory
notes: Listing page has JSON-LD events (usually just 1–3 productions).

name: Troxy
notes: Event pages carry <time datetime> dates; cached so daily runs only fetch new events.

name: Ticketmaster (London theatre, music, comedy & talks)
notes: Official Discovery API (free key, 5,000 calls/day; ~140 calls/run for 12 months). Needs the TICKETMASTER_API_KEY Actions secret; skipped without it. Covers West End/large venues, including ones whose sites block GitHub servers (e.g. Official London Theatre). Also gives performance schedules, on-sale dates and performers.

name: Skiddle (London theatre, comedy, exhibitions, arts & gigs)
notes: Official Skiddle events API (free key). Needs the SKIDDLE_API_KEY Actions secret; 'skipped' without it.
